text: あいてに　めいちゅうを　さげられない

structure.jp: めいちゅうを　さげられない
structure.en: does not get its accuracy lowered

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.span: あいてに　めいちゅうを　さげられない
patterns.explanation: The られる ending says the thing is done to you, and the one who does it gets に. あいてに さげられない = 'is not lowered by the opponent'.
